id.description: Immutable canonical UUID for this financing instrument, facility, issuance, or capital contribution.

schema_version.description: Version of the JSON Schema contract used to validate this record; it changes only through documented repository migrations.

created_at.description: UTC date-time when this repository record was first created; this is audit metadata, not the real-world entity's founding or start date.

modified_at.description: UTC date-time of the latest repository record change; it must be updated whenever a structured value or its provenance changes.

source_ids.description: Non-empty set of Source Registry IDs that directly support the observed, estimated, or derived values in this record.

confidence_score.description: Evidence-strength score from 1 (unverified or speculative) to 5 (verified SEC filing), assigned under ASSUMPTIONS.md.

status.description: Current lifecycle classification for the represented entity or record; unknown is used when available evidence does not establish a state.

notes.description: Optional analyst clarification about scope, ambiguity, estimation, or lifecycle context; null means no clarification is recorded and notes never replace structured provenance.

company_id.description: UUID of the borrowing, issuing, or recipient Company; foreign key to Company.id.

campus_id.description: Optional UUID of a specifically financed Campus; foreign key to Campus.id and null for company-level or project-only financing.

project_id.description: Optional UUID of a specifically financed Project; foreign key to Project.id and null for company-level or campus-only financing.

financing_type.description: Allowed classification of the instrument's legal or economic form.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency in which principal_amount is denominated.

principal_amount.description: Observed or derived original committed or issued principal amount in the adjacent currency, measured in whole currency units and never negative.

interest_rate.description: Optional observed annualized contractual interest rate as a decimal fraction where 0.08 means 8%; null for equity, undisclosed, or non-interest-bearing instruments.

issue_date.description: Optional observed ISO 8601 closing, issuance, or funding date; null when unknown or not yet completed.

maturity_date.description: Optional observed ISO 8601 contractual maturity date; null for perpetual instruments or when unknown.

lender_or_investor.description: Optional observed lender, investor, or capital-provider name; null when undisclosed or broadly syndicated without a canonical counterparty.
